title: Multi-physics mechanisms and regulation of perovskite grain boundaries: insights into carrier dynamics, ion migration, thermodynamics, and thermal stress
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,7291-7301
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE02240A, Paper
Luolei Shi, Xirui Liu, Yuqi Zhang, Yining Bao, Tianshu Ma, Linling Qin, Guoyang Cao, Changlei Wang, Chuanxiao Xiao, Xiaofeng Li, Zhenhai Yang
This study investigates the multi-physics mechanisms of grain boundaries in perovskite solar cells by performing opto-electro-thermal-stress coupled simulations, with analyses from carrier transport, ion migration, thermodynamics, and thermal stress.
